subject.title: feat(agents): configured agent env reaches spawned subprocesses

question: Should OpenClaw accept broad literal `agents.list[].env` for CLI, exec, ACP/ACPX, and stdio MCP child processes, or prefer the narrower exec-only SecretRef direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96309?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent but changes a public config and credential boundary across several runtime owners, and automation cannot choose the durable product/security contract.

options.title: Choose the env contract first
options.body: Resolve broad literal per-agent env versus exec-only SecretRef, then land the branch that matches that decision.

options.title: Accept this broad contract
options.body: Treat this PR as the canonical sanitized child-process env surface once the remaining CI/check drift is refreshed.

options.title: Pause behind exec-only SecretRef
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it later only if the exec-only SecretRef alternative becomes the accepted and merged implementation.

recommendation.title: Choose the env contract first
recommendation.body: Resolve broad literal per-agent env versus exec-only SecretRef, then land the branch that matches that decision.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion explicitly asks vincentkoc for follow-up based on predecessor guidance, and local history connects this person to config/helper and env-boundary work.
